home.heading: Build better habits.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

overview.emptyDescription: Today's habits, tasks, focus time and progress will be summarised here.

habits.emptyDescription: Habits you create, with their schedules, streaks and history, will appear here.

goals.emptyDescription: Goals with milestones and measurable progress will appear here.

tasks.emptyDescription: Tasks with subtasks, priorities and due dates will appear here, in list, calendar and board views.

planner.emptyDescription: Plan your day and week, and prioritise with the Eisenhower matrix, here.

focus.emptyDescription: Focus timers and your session history will appear here.

journal.emptyDescription: Daily reflections and notes will appear here. Your journal stays private.

insights.emptyDescription: Trends, weekly reviews and experiments based on your activity will appear here.

coach.emptyTitle: The AI coach isn't available yet
coach.emptyDescription: Personal suggestions based on your progress will appear here. It never changes your data without your confirmation.

settings.emptyDescription: Profile, preferences, notifications, privacy, billing, integrations and accountability settings will live here.

apiErrors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
